summary: Liquidia filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) disclosing a September 30, 2026 update in United Therapeutics' Hatch-Waxman litigation in the U.S. District Court for the District of Delaware over U.S. Patent No. 11,826,327 and Liquidia's lead product YUTREPIA (treprostinil) inhalation powder. The court held claims 1 and 14 valid and infringed, while the remaining asserted claims were invalid. The parties must submit a proposed form of judgment specifying remedies within one week. No board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms were disclosed. Not a special situation.
